name: Yumeji Maria
source:
Due to her house doubling as a church, Maria is deeply religious and frequently quotes the Bible. Gentle by nature, she is slow and unathletic, often falling magnificently even when there's nothing to cause it. She's childhood friends with [url=/c98282]Kana[/url], whom she refers to as "Ume-chan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
